title: The Quad Reassessed: Key Takeaways
gist: ASPI's roundtable finds the Quad has kept ministerial momentum in 2026 despite no leaders' summit so far, with a summit now confirmed for the November 2026 ASEAN Summit in Manila. Its prospects hinge on strained U.S.-India ties and Washington's go-it-alone China approach, while critical minerals and energy cooperation remain largely bilateral and the group failed to act collectively on the Iran crisis.
